C0180.title: "Your Negative Review Has Been Deleted"—Who Did It? This Group Made 900,000 RMB by Fabrication
C0180.summary: In March 2026, Shanghai Minhang police cracked a corporate 'online water army' case, dismantling a criminal gang specializing in paid deletion of negative reviews. The group exploited platform moderation loopholes by fabricating extortion chat logs and mass-posting fake reviews, deleting over 4,500 negative reviews for more than 700 merchants, with the amount involved reaching over 900,000 RMB.
